projects.name: Description
projects.description:
Description
The project aimed to enhance Pinkerton is the leading Service institution that provides services such as advisory, Security, Investigations, and other services to corporations or large businesses, as required to individual members of the public, Commercial business by implementing a comprehensive solution integrated with Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and CRM. The objective was to streamline operations, automate business processes, and ensure seamless synchronization between financial, operational, and customer data.
I was responsible for gathering business requirements, conducting fit-gap analysis, and preparing functional design documents. I collaborated closely with business stakeholders through workshops and client meetings to refine business rules and ensure the solution aligned with operational needs.
A key aspect of the project involved designing and implementing integrations between Dynamics 365 modules to enable real-time data flow across systems, improving data accuracy and reducing manual intervention. Additionally, I supported the team in functional clarifications, provided end- user training, and delivered product demonstrations to business SMEs.
This initiative resulted in improved operational efficiency, enhanced visibility into vehicle and fleet data, and empowered the client with better decision- making capabilities through integrated business intelligence.

projects.description:
Platform/tools Description
ACH 825 sub ledger. 20 Feb 2019 -31 Aug 2020 Citi bank. Desktop Automation Process (Python)
The project focused on automating and streamlining the processing of debit and credit transactions received through the ACH 825 sub-ledger, a core component of Citi Bank’s retail banking services. The objective was to ensure accurate and efficient handling of financial transactions based on market, transaction amount, and reason type, as defined in the ACH 825 requests.
I was actively involved in requirement gathering, preparing detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), and designing process flow diagrams using Microsoft Visio. My role also included coordinating with the technical team for requirement clarifications, managing deliverables, and collaborating closely with business stakeholders through one-on-one discussions and workshops.
Additionally, I participated in weekly client meetings to provide status updates, assisted team members in understanding business functionality, and conducted demonstrations and presentations for customer SMEs. Post- implementation, I documented the finalized process flows to support smooth transition and operational consistency.
This initiative enhanced transaction accuracy, improved process, transparency, and strengthened the overall efficiency of Citi Bank’s ACH 825 sub-ledger operations. and version control support.

The primary objective was to identify zero-balance accounts across two source systems, validate account details, and process closure requests based on the customer-provided closure reasons. This initiative aimed to ensure accuracy, compliance, and efficiency in handling account termination requests.
